study_identification_part.si4_title: Detecting accelerated retinal decline in mental disorders through normative modeling

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: To build normative models of age-related macular retinal thickness (and sublayers RNFL, GC-IPL) in UK Biobank healthy controls and test whether schizophrenia, bipolar disorder, and major depressive disorder show accelerated decline and deviations from the normative patterns.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: SZ and BD show accelerated, disorder-specific retinal thinning relative to normative expectations (largest in SZ), while MDD shows no robust thinning; RNFL shows no consistent differences.
